goal: Turn the complete Phase 57J decisions into bounded longitudinal transition records and explicit reopening contracts without treating a classified transition or defined trigger as evidence that an operating event occurred.
publication_rule: Publish only reviewed transition controls and longitudinal panels; preserve all nine holds until their machine-readable contracts receive complete qualifying evidence and human review.
authority_rule: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN control classifications, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak's longitudinal matrix contains 356 identity-snapshot presence cells
records.finding: All 178 historical identities receive one bounded state in each of two retained source snapshots, producing 356 explicit cells.
records.denominator: 178 identities by two source snapshots: 356 cells.
evidence_limits: Snapshot presence is not current physical presence.
Cohort nonobservation is not deletion.
Operating outcomes remain null.
records.next_action: Append later code-bearing snapshots only through the same identity and effective-period contract.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN control classifications, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak classifies 178 longitudinal source transitions without asserting asset changes
records.finding: Eleven rows move from historical presence to a bounded current cohort observation; 167 move to current nonobservation with no deletion inference.
records.denominator: 178 transition rows: eleven bounded observations and 167 nonobservations.
evidence_limits: A classified row is not evidence of a structural transition.
Nonobservation is not removal or failure.
No reliability measure is inferred.
records.next_action: Reclassify only when a later official snapshot supplies stable identity and effective period.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN control classifications, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.denominator: Sixteen names across one retained review queue.
evidence_limits: A controlled alias is not an official rename.
Unresolved rows remain visible.
No station code is guessed.

records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN control classifications, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.
